display_long_description:
Terror Taxi VR, A taxi driving and shooting game you navigate a Zombie infested city, pick up  passengers, and deliver them safely to earn your pay. Defend your cab from zombie creatures using a heavy arsenal of weapons or your gun from glove box . You can Use your hard-earned cash to upgrade your ride. Spend your earnings on deadly roof-mounted turrets including flamethrowers, lasers, and rocket launchers and deck out your dashboard with custom bobbleheads.
[media]
[media]

🚕 The Ultimate VR Taxi Survival: Find fares, collect cash, and navigate the dangerous streets of a monster-filled city.

🔫 Arm Your Cab: Spend your earnings on deadly roof-mounted turrets—including flamethrowers, lasers, and rocket launchers—and deck out your dashboard with custom bobbleheads.

🧽 Immersive VR Interactions:  Listen to your quirky passengers, manually operate your turret joystick, and you can interact physically with NPC passengers.

💰 Manage Your Hustle: Every bullet costs money. Balance your ammo spending with your trip earnings to stay profitable and stay alive!
